gold.title: Off-by-one error in range boundary: `range(len(readings) - self.window_size)` produces indices 0 through N-W-1, but the
gold.description: Off-by-one error in range boundary: `range(len(readings) - self.window_size)` produces indices 0 through N-W-1, but the correct range is 0 through N-W (inclusive). The docstring states this should return N - W + 1 values, but it returns N - W values instead, silently dropping the last valid window. Use `range(len(readings) - self.window_size + 1)` to include the final window position.

candidate.title: Sliding window loop drops final window — off-by-one in range
candidate.description: Loop yields N - W instead of N - W + 1 averages as documented. smooth([1,2,3,4,5,6,7]) with window_size=5 returns 2 values instead of 3; when len(readings) == window_size, returns [] instead of single average. detect_anomalies inherits this: trailing readings never checked for anomalies. Fix: range(len(readings) - self.window_size + 1)
